2609.18338.title: Autonomy in Check: Governor-Mediated Adaptive Security at the Edge
2609.18338.paper_summary: Adaptive security at the network edge increasingly relies on automated planners, including rule-based controllers, learned policies, and LLM-assisted agents, that translate observations into enforcement actions. Once such a planner can influence live policy state, syntactic validity is not enough. A semantically wrong action, produced from incomplete or manipulated observations, can be faithfully executed by an enforcement substrate that cannot judge mission context. We address this problem by treating the boundary between planner output and kernel enforcement input as the primary security object. We propose a split-control architecture in which an untrusted planner emits typed security intents, a deterministic governor checks each intent against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, and only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into pre-installed eBPF map updates. The paper formalizes this trust-boundary problem, defines three threat classes, develops the governor admission predicate, and reports an end-to-end prototype. Across rule-based and LLM-assisted planners on a Raspberry Pi 5 testbed connected to the university 5G Test Network, the governor admits, rejects, and bounds intents at microsecond cost without disrupting protected-flow regularity. The contribution is conceptual as much as empirical: adaptive security does not need to trust the author of an action. It needs a mediation boundary that decides whether the action is admissible.
2609.18338.paper_summary_zh: 自適應安全在網絡邊緣越來越依賴自動化規劃者，包括基於規則的控制器、學習的策略和LLM輔助的代理，這些代理將觀察轉化為執行行動。當這樣的規劃者能夠影響實時政策狀態時，語法有效性已經不再足夠。從不完整或被操縱的觀察中產生的語義錯誤行動，可能會被無法判斷任務上下文的執行基礎忠實執行。我們通過將規劃者輸出和內核執行輸入之間的邊界視為主要的安全對象來解決這個問題。我們提出了一種分離控制架構，其中不受信任的規劃者發出類型化的安全意圖，一個確定性的管理者檢查每個意圖是否符合安全性、資源、時間穩定性和比例不變性，只有被接受的行動才會綁定到簽名收據並編譯成預裝的eBPF映射更新。本文形式化了這一信任邊界問題，定義了三個威脅類別，開發了管理者接受謂詞，並報告了一個端到端原型。在連接到大學5G測試網絡的Raspberry Pi 5測試平台上，管理者以微秒成本接受、拒絕和限制意圖，而不干擾受保護流的規律性。這一貢獻既是概念性的也是實證性的：自適應安全不需要信任行動的作者。它需要一個調解邊界來決定該行動是否可接受。
